rows.grounds: bhinne = when-divided (loc.sg.n. of bhinna, past participle of √bhid)
tvakhile = but-entire (tu = but, indecl.; akhile = loc.sg.n. of akhila)
vedye = knowable (loc.sg.n. of vedya, gerundive of √vid)
mantreśāstanmaheśāstu = lords-of-mantras-and-great-lords-but (mantreśāḥ = nom.pl.m. of mantreśa; tanmaheśāḥ = nom.pl.m. of tanmaheśa; tu = but, indecl.)
bhinnābhinne = divided-and-undivided (nom.pl.m. dvandva of bhinna + abhinna)
suśivānto@dhvoditaḥ = up-to-sadashiva-path-arisen (nom.sg.m. compound: suśiva-anta-adhvan + udita, past participle of ud-√i)
prete = in-the-lord (loc.sg.m. of pretṛ, agent noun from pra-√i; AMBIGUOUS: could also be loc.sg. of preta 'departed spirit', but gloss indicates 'lord')
